# Mishti Saxena — Urban Designer, Sydney

> A personal landing page for Mishti Saxena, an urban designer in Sydney who helps NSW landowners work out what their land can really become, before they spend on drawings.

## Who she is

- Mishti Saxena, Urban Designer at Land Specialists Pty Ltd, Sydney.
- Master of Urbanism (Urban Design), University of Sydney. Bachelor of Architecture, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, Delhi.
- She works with the NSW planning system every day: LEPs, DCPs, SEPPs, planning proposals, subdivision, concept design and DA support.

## Free offers

- A free 20–30 minute chat: an honest first take on what your land could become.
- A free Quick Zoning Check: what your zoning allows, what could hold the site back, and what to do next.
- A free guide: "7 Costly Mistakes Landowners Make" (PDF download on the page).

## Paid services

- Site feasibility and yield studies; planning research and briefing notes; subdivision and lot layout design; concept design and massing; 3D renders and visualisations; DA support; urban design reports.
- The first chat and the zoning check are free. Any paid work gets a written scope and a fixed fee in advance, before you decide anything.

## Service area

- Greater Sydney, the Central Coast and the Hunter. Land elsewhere in NSW is welcome too; she will say honestly if she can help.

## Note

- The free zoning check is general information, not legal or planning advice. Planning controls change; verify with council. No outcome, approval or yield is guaranteed.
